        LD      A,(HL)
label   ld a,b ;ld a,b AND LD A,B
        defb "LD A",1,"ld"

        db "AF'",AF' ,af'

        ld a,"A"
        LD A,"A"
PP      equ 10 ; EQU
MIXED   lD A,B
